done_when: When forge init or adoption sets a repo's test command, it also sets fast_test to a changed-only command for the repo's test tool when it recognises one (vitest: vitest related or --changed {base}; jest: --changedSince {base}; pytest: the test files that changed since {base} plus those that import a changed module), and leaves it unset otherwise; the skill tells the agent to propose one when a repo has none. Forge's own forge.toml sets fast_test the same way for its pytest suite. Command-level tests cover init in a vitest repo, a jest repo, a pytest repo and an unknown one.
why: Repos only get change-based test runs at close if someone sets fast_test by hand, so most closes still run the full suite that CI runs again
